title: Nonparametric autoregressive estimation of probability distributions with parallel gradient boosting
abstract: arXiv:2610.31524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nonparametric estimation of joint probability distributions is a core problem in statistics, which is notoriously challenging with high-dimensional data. Such challenges also arise with conditional distribution estimation and have led to flexible algorithms that aim to tackle the ''curse of dimensionality'' by exploiting predictive structures of lower dimension than the ambient space. In this paper, we study the use of such conditional distribution estimators to estimate joint distributions by factorizing the latter in an ''autoregressive'' way. We show that for loss functions satisfying a subadditivity property, bounds on the convergence rate of an autoregressive estimator can be derived from bounds on the convergence rate of the conditional distribution estimators. translated_title: 基于并行梯度提升的概率分布非参数自回归估计
translated_abstract: 联合概率分布的非参数估计是统计学中的一个核心问题，在高维数据下这一问题以困难著称。类似的挑战也出现在条件分布估计中，由此催生了一批灵活的算法，它们通过利用维数低于环境空间的预测结构来应对“维数灾难”。在本文中，我们研究如何利用这类条件分布估计器，通过以“自回归”方式对联合分布进行因子分解来估计联合分布。我们证明，对于满足次可加性性质的损失函数，自回归估计器的收敛速度界可以从条件分布估计器的收敛速度界推导得出。这些界将估计联合分布的难度与估计自回归分解中最困难因子的难度联系起来。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过自回归因子分解将联合概率分布的估计转化为条件分布估计，并证明在满足次可加性的损失函数下，自回归估计器的收敛速度界可由条件分布估计器的收敛速度界导出，从而将联合分布估计的难度归结为自回归分解中最难因子的估计难度，并借助并行梯度提升实现高效估计。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes nonparametric autoregressive estimation of joint probability distributions via factorization into conditional distribution estimators (implemented with parallel gradient boosting), proving that for subadditive loss functions, convergence rate bounds of the autoregressive estimator can be derived from those of the conditional estimators, tying joint estimation difficulty to the hardest factor in the factorization.
